claim: Patchline ships a hazard-taxonomy completeness argument with a canonical-form algorithm and coverage proof. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the taxonomy completeness claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make hazard-taxonomy-completeness-gate`.
